design: Hard questions that need the web: guidance given only on earnings calls, recent events (incl. point-in-time as_of traps), foreign issuers' local-currency results, private companies' self-published figures vs media estimates, and multi-hop calculations combining a web-only fact with reported figures. Built blind by a research subagent from primary sources (company releases, IR decks, exchange filings, NHTSA) and reputable news; split from a 20-question pool at random within each of 5 categories (seed 20261005); the other half is evals/web_dev.jsonl.
verification: Every key figure re-opened at its source by the builder; rows resting on secondary sources are listed in evals/web_sources.md. Spot checks against SEC XBRL (ACV revenue, Akamai cash and securities) matched.
rule: Frozen before any agent run on it; no agent code or search-setting choice made in response to its results.
